text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْخَمْرُ وَٱلْمَيْسِرُ وَٱلْأَنصَابُ وَٱلْأَزْلَٰمُ رِجْسٌۭ مِّنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَٱجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

words.gloss_range: vocative particle opening a direct summons
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens the ayah as a summons before any prohibited item is named. The prohibition is therefore not an abstract notice; it is delivered to a present community that must listen before the verdict and command unfold.

topics.headline: opening summons scopes the ruling
topics.summary: Covers 4 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first creates an addressed listening situation before naming any prohibited object.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on the vocative particle as the address frame for the full prohibition sequence.

words.gloss_range: formal vocative support that intensifies and holds the addressee before specification
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) lengthens the opening call and holds the addressee in view until the relative description arrives. Its alerting force makes the ruling feel formally public: attention first, identity next, command later.

topics.headline: formal alert before class identity
topics.summary: Covers 8 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the staged address: open attention is intensified before the believers are specified.
topics.reason: The rows preserve the vocative support, hā alert force, sound expansion, and boundary shift into public address.

words.gloss_range: plural relative pronoun defining the addressed class through the following trust clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) turns the address into a defined class rather than an unnamed audience. The listeners are specified by the following trust clause, so the later avoidance command belongs to a community already marked by covenant identity.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the addressees
topics.summary: Covers 7 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is grammatically tied to people defined by prior trust, not to an anonymous crowd.
topics.reason: The rows all point to the relative pronoun as the mechanism that embeds identity before the verdict.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form IV trust/belief used without an explicit object, naming the audience by prior trust
words.root_gloss_range: security, safety, trust, and belief; locally realized as Form IV prior trust rather than a fresh command to believe
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) completes the address by treating trust as already present. Its objectless perfect Form IV makes the audience a trust-community before the rijs field appears, and that opening is later answered by hoped success through the avoidance command at the close.

topics.headline: perfect Form IV names prior trust
topics.summary: Covers 13 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is presupposed as identity before the prohibition, and the objectless verb keeps that trust relation broad.
topics.reason: The grammar, root, form, and objectless rows jointly support prior trust as the addressee identity.

topics.headline: trust-address points toward success closure
topics.summary: Covers 10 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar believer-address formula is specialized here by a route from trust to hoped success through avoidance.
topics.reason: The recurrence, position, boundary, and same-surah rows connect the opening trust clause with the closing success formula.

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle setting a categorical nominal verdict
words.root_gloss_range: fused emphatic-restrictive particle field; locally functions as qaṣr over the four-item predicate
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) moves from address into restriction: the four named categories are not left for balancing or soft evaluation, but are confined to one verdict. Its internal particle analysis blocks ordinary emphatic case-governance, so the word functions as a scope device over a nominal equation, and its restrictive style continues in the adversary-intent explanation in 5:91.

topics.headline: restriction selected over softer parses
topics.summary: Covers 8 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle makes the verdict categorical, while the alternative parse only sharpens what the standard reading prevents.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows about kāffa, blocked governance, and parse contrast survive as a narrowed account of local restriction.

topics.headline: restriction organizes the ayah architecture
topics.summary: Covers 10 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the five-beat movement from address to restricted verdict to source to command to hoped success.
topics.reason: The structural and echo rows show that the particle governs the clause frame and anticipates the next restrictive statement in 5:91.

words.gloss_range: definite category of mind-covering intoxicant, not an isolated drink token
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, veiling, fermenting; locally narrowed to the intellect-covering category under the rijs verdict
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْخَمْرُ}} ({{tr:al-khamru}}) begins the list with a definite category, not a one-off instance. The covering root makes the item more than a beverage label: the local issue is mind-covering, while the body-covering echo in 24:31 shows why the root field must be narrowed by context. Its first position starts the ayah's chain of compromised agency.

topics.headline: covering root becomes mind-covering category
topics.summary: Covers 11 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word targets a class of intellect-covering intoxicants, not only a named beverage token, and that the root’s covering field is narrowed locally rather than treating every covering as forbidden.
topics.reason: The root, definiteness, nominal-form, and derivative rows support the covering payoff, narrowed to the local mind-covering category.

topics.headline: first item starts the agency-loss chain
topics.summary: Covers 12 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the list begins with impaired perception before moving to shortcut gain, cultic markers, and decision tools.
topics.reason: The position, pairing, recurrence, and same-surah explanation rows preserve the first-item role in the four-part rijs system.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the second item into the same predicate chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pulls the second item into the same grammatical verdict as the first. It keeps maysir from becoming a separate aside and makes the first pair a coordinated field of impaired judgment and shortcut gain.

topics.headline: first conjunction equalizes the second item
topics.summary: Covers 5 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that maysir is grammatically coequal with khamr under the same verdict, not a secondary explanation.
topics.reason: The rows all preserve the wa-coordination that joins the second definite category to the same predicate chain.

words.gloss_range: definite category of chance-gain or gambling as an instrument of effortless gain
words.root_gloss_range: ease, facilitation, and easy acquisition; locally narrowed to corrupted ease-seeking through chance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَيْسِرُ}} ({{tr:al-maysiru}}) names a definite shortcut system built from the root of ease. The payoff is the corruption of ease: beneficial facilitation in 2:185 and 94:5-6 is narrowed here into chance-gain that bypasses work and is co-classified with the other rijs items.

topics.headline: ease root becomes shortcut instrument
topics.summary: Covers 9 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word corrupts the otherwise positive field of ease into chance-gain that bypasses effort.
topics.reason: The semantic and form rows support yusr as beneficial ease elsewhere while narrowing the local noun to maysir as an instrument of shortcut gain.

topics.headline: maysir joins the khamr legal pair
topics.summary: Covers 13 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that impaired perception and chance-gain form a recurring paired prohibition field, not two accidental examples.
topics.reason: The grammar, distribution, echo, and position rows keep maysir inside the recurring khamr-maysir field of 2:219, 5:90, and 5:91.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the erected-marker category to the same list
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) widens the same list rather than starting a new clause. By attaching the erected markers to the first pair, the ayah expands the rijs field from perception and gain into cultic authority.

topics.headline: second conjunction widens the list
topics.summary: Covers 4 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the list expanding from appetite and gain into cultic authority without changing predicate or grammatical status.
topics.reason: The rows converge on the second conjunction as an additive link that keeps anṣāb under the same delayed verdict.

words.gloss_range: definite plural for erected cultic markers or objects of misplaced devotion
words.root_gloss_range: setting up, erecting, appointing, portions, and toil; locally narrowed to erected markers in the rijs list
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَنصَابُ}} ({{tr:al-anṣābu}}) is a definite plural for erected markers, so the danger is not only one stone or one ritual location but a recognized system of raised objects of devotion. The portion and office fields keep an authority-and-allocation pressure visible, while the rare form and echo of 5:3 make this a Surah 5 legal category, not a loose image.

topics.headline: rare plural localizes erected authority
topics.summary: Covers 10 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exact plural points to a system of erected devotion-markers, while broader root fields remain secondary pressure.
topics.reason: The root, plural-form, rarity, and derivative rows support false erected authority, narrowed to the local cultic-marker category.

topics.headline: Surah 5 echo broadens the prohibition
topics.summary: Covers 12 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the term reworks 5:3 sacrificial material into this four-item rijs verdict.
topics.reason: The position, co-occurrence, and echo rows connect anṣāb with azlām and the same-surah prohibition cluster.

words.gloss_range: final coordinating conjunction completing the four-item subject chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) completes the enumeration before the predicate arrives. The repeated connector lets each item remain audible as its own category while preparing the singular verdict that will gather all four together.

topics.headline: final conjunction completes the fourfold list
topics.summary: Covers 4 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predicate is delayed until all four categories have been heard separately.
topics.reason: The rows all show the last conjunction completing the list while maintaining one subject chain.

words.gloss_range: definite plural for divining lot-arrows as decision-outsourcing tools
words.root_gloss_range: cutting or trimming; locally selected as trimmed instruments used for lots/divination
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَزْلَٰمُ}} ({{tr:al-azlāmu}}) closes the list with known divining tools. The trimming-root image makes the arrows deliberately stripped instruments, not ordinary tools for action, and their final position makes decision-outsourcing the last domain folded into the rijs verdict.

topics.headline: trimmed arrows materialize outsourced judgment
topics.summary: Covers 9 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final item makes agency transfer concrete: decisions are handed to manufactured lot-tools.
topics.reason: The semantic, form, and object rows converge on known divination arrows as concrete devices of decision-outsourcing.

topics.headline: near-hapax form closes the agency-loss list
topics.summary: Covers 14 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare word is confined to the same Surah 5 prohibition field and lands immediately before the singular verdict.
topics.reason: The rarity, echo, boundary, and final-position rows make azlām the concentrated closure of the four-item enumeration.

words.gloss_range: singular indefinite predicate that gathers four categories into one contamination verdict
words.root_gloss_range: filth, impurity, disturbance, and consequence-bearing contamination; locally the evaluative predicate for the whole list
words.prose: {{ar:رِجْسٌۭ}} ({{tr:rijsun}}) is the hinge of the ayah: four definite categories collapse into one indefinite contamination-kind. Its impurity and disturbance range makes the verdict more than static dirt; it is disruptive contamination, which explains why the later command avoids the field as one object rather than negotiating each item separately.

topics.headline: singular predicate compresses four subjects
topics.summary: Covers 9 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that four definite categories are converted into one contamination field, which later becomes the singular object of avoidance.
topics.reason: The grammar and form rows support singular indefinite rijs as predicate, category compressor, and likely antecedent for the later suffix.

topics.headline: rijs combines impurity with disturbance
topics.summary: Covers 13 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is not neutral classification but contamination with disruptive force, explaining why avoidance is required.
topics.reason: The semantic, distribution, and echo rows preserve the impurity-disturbance payoff and the avoidance parallels in 22:30 and 33:33.

words.gloss_range: preposition binding the verdict to its source or explicative origin phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) attaches the verdict to its source phrase. It can carry both origin and explication here: the rijs comes from adversarial work and is characterized as that work, which prepares the causal turn to the command.

topics.headline: min binds verdict to adversarial source
topics.summary: Covers 7 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes source part of the verdict itself: the rijs comes from and is characterized by adversarial work.
topics.reason: The rows support both source and explicative force, narrowed to a compact phrase that prepares the causal command.

words.gloss_range: construct gerund naming the listed field as an adversarial product
words.root_gloss_range: work, doing, acting, and production; locally a construct product attributed to the adversary
words.prose: {{ar:عَمَلِ}} ({{tr:ʿamali}}) makes the four-item field a product, not merely a set of temptations. In construct with the next word, it attributes manufacture to the adversarial source and contrasts with accountable human action after 5:89; unlike 8:48, where deeds are adorned, here the work is attributed as the adversary's own.

topics.headline: construct phrase assigns production agency
topics.summary: Covers 11 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the four items are framed as outputs of an adversarial production system, not random social habits.
topics.reason: The genitive, subjective iḍāfa, construct, and semantic rows all support work/product attributed to the adversary.

topics.headline: human action language is inverted
topics.summary: Covers 9 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between accountable human action and the adversary's own work, especially against 8:48 and the surrounding legal passage.
topics.reason: The recurrence and boundary rows preserve the inversion from believers' deeds to the adversarial product named here.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive producer inside the construct source phrase
words.root_gloss_range: remoteness, opposition, and rebellious adversarial force; locally remoteness is the favored derivational pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ}} ({{tr:ash-shayṭāni}}) completes the source phrase as a definite genitive producer. The remoteness root pressure fits the listed practices: they distance trust, judgment, devotion, and deliberation. The work named here becomes will and purpose in 5:91, while 14:22 keeps that production distinct from coercive control.

topics.headline: definite genitive source favors remoteness
topics.summary: Covers 12 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the producer is grammatically identifiable and semantically a distancing force, while the burning derivation does not govern this local parse.
topics.reason: The genitive, definiteness, singular-form, and root rows support the producer role, narrowed to remoteness/opposition as the local derivational pressure.

topics.headline: source phrase anticipates intent explanation
topics.summary: Covers 9 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the work named here becomes will and purpose in 5:91, while 14:22 keeps responsibility from becoming coercion.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence, position, and echo rows show the source phrase as the bridge from product in 5:90 to intent in 5:91 and non-coercion in 14:22.

words.gloss_range: causal/resultative connector turning verdict into command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the pivot from diagnosis to action. Because the four categories are rijs from adversarial work, the command follows as a consequence rather than as an unrelated instruction.

topics.headline: resultative fa turns verdict into command
topics.summary: Covers 6 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that avoidance follows because of the classification and source phrase, not as an isolated rule.
topics.reason: The rows all support the particle as the causal/resultative pivot from rijs-source diagnosis to imperative response.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII imperative with plural addressee and singular object suffix, commanding active separation from the unified rijs field
words.root_gloss_range: side, flank, and keeping aside; locally Form VIII self-involving avoidance with an explicit singular object
words.prose: {{ar:ٱجْتَنِبُوهُ}} ({{tr:ijtanibūhu}}) compresses the whole verdict into one command-word. The singular suffix gathers the four items through rijs as one object, while Form VIII and the side-root tell the addressed community to create active distance from that contamination field. The explicit rijs-avoidance pattern in 22:30, the ritual side-state contrast in 5:6, and the cessation uptake in 5:91 clarify the command without replacing its local grammar.

topics.headline: singular suffix gathers the whole rijs field
topics.summary: Covers 4 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that four listed items become one avoidable object through the singular suffix mediated by rijs.
topics.reason: The suffix, object, and compression rows support the collective argument routed through the singular predicate.

topics.headline: Form VIII commands self-involving separation
topics.summary: Covers 15 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that avoidance is an active spatial act of placing the contamination field to the side, performed by the addressed community.
topics.reason: The imperative, Form VIII, side-root, and agency rows preserve the concrete self-distancing payoff.

topics.headline: avoidance command is clarified by parallels
topics.summary: Covers 6 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 22:30 makes the rijs-avoidance pattern explicit, while 5:6 and 5:91 sharpen boundary and cessation without replacing the local command.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah and boundary rows survive as parallels and forward uptake, narrowed so they clarify rather than govern the local parse.

words.gloss_range: hope/expectation particle plus second-person plural suffix tying outcome to the same audience
words.prose: {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}) opens the final outcome clause with hope rather than automatic guarantee. Its second-person plural suffix keeps the same believers in view: those summoned at the start are the ones whose success is sought through avoidance.

topics.headline: hope particle keeps outcome conditional
topics.summary: Covers 7 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that success is attached to avoidance as a hoped result for the same addressed community, not as an automatic guarantee.
topics.reason: The rows preserve tarajjī modality, second-person continuity, closure position, and the boundary link from hoped gratitude to hoped success.

words.gloss_range: imperfect Form IV second-person plural success verb, prospective after avoidance
words.root_gloss_range: cleaving/ploughing and prospering; locally Form IV success as a cultivated outcome rather than bare physical cleaving
words.prose: {{ar:تُفْلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:tufliḥūna}}) leaves the ayah on prospective success, not on rijs or the adversary. The Form IV success verb carries the old cleaving/ploughing image into attained prosperity: avoidance is the route by which the community may cultivate an opened future.

topics.headline: imperfect plural success closes the command
topics.summary: Covers 14 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that success remains prospective and communal, dependent on the prior avoidance route.
topics.reason: The grammar, form, formula, final-position, and trust-frame rows show success as the hoped future of the addressed group.

topics.headline: falāḥ preserves cultivated breakthrough
topics.summary: Covers 9 CRITICAL rows for this word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that success carries an agricultural cleaving-open image, while Form IV selects attained prosperity rather than bare ploughing.
topics.reason: The semantic, derivative, form, and echo rows preserve the cultivated payoff, narrowed by the actual Form IV success sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four-item list is singularized as rijs from an intentional work and met by the spatial command fajtanibuhu.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering judgment, chance-partition, erected sacrificial authority, and decision by arrows operate as one coupled practice-system. Its rijs is not inert dirt alone: intentional use turns the parts into confusion and crooked distance, so avoidance means leaving the operating system rather than merely disliking four objects.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the system's impairment of perception.
Gambling by lots and partition of a slaughtered camel supply its chance-allocation mechanism.
An erected stone for worship or slaughter supplies a material focal point for the system.
Confusion and entanglement make rijs the system's cognitive and practical output.
Employing an instrument makes the named things components activated by use.
Opposition, crookedness, and deviation characterize the direction produced by that work.
Active distancing and withdrawal supply the required system-level response.

changed_reading.before: Four independently forbidden objects are called filthy and must be avoided.
changed_reading.after: Four components form one intentionally operated social and epistemic system; its product is confusion and crooked distance, so the command exits the whole configuration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-maysir stands inside the rejected list while tuflihun states the promised result.
baseline_models.mechanism: Maysir offers ease, wealth, and gain by lots; falah also names cutting open and cultivating soil before it names lasting success. The verse opposes shortcut acquisition to worked, durable flourishing: one leaves the easy-gain apparatus in order to open and cultivate a viable future.

activation_trace.role: Ease after difficulty supplies the shortcut's attractive promise.
Wealth and abundance supply the promised payoff of the shortcut.
Gambling and lot-based division show how the promised ease is operationalized.
Cutting and opening supply the laboring action beneath flourishing.
The farmer who opens soil supplies a cultivated rather than accidental gain model.
Victory with enduring good supplies the long-horizon result.

changed_reading.before: Avoid gambling so that success may follow.
changed_reading.after: Reject the seductive economy of easy, lucky gain so that success can instead be cut open, cultivated, and made durable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Khamr, ansab, azlam, rijs, and amal combine concealment, markers, decision devices, confusion, and instrument-use.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cluster can be read as a false uncertainty-management apparatus: it covers what is seen, erects signs and fixed measures, then uses arrows to manufacture a decision. The result is not knowledge but entanglement, while amal marks the apparatus as something people actively operate.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the obscured field in which the apparatus claims to decide.
An erected boundary marker supplies externally fixed orientation.
A fixed origin or threshold supplies the apparatus's claim to measure.
Confusion and entanglement identify the actual epistemic result.
Instrument-use makes false orientation a manufactured practice rather than a passive mistake.

changed_reading.before: Divining arrows are one prohibited ritual item among several.
changed_reading.after: The list exposes an operated apparatus that first obscures reality and then claims to resolve it through erected signs, measures, and arrows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding frame forbids making wholesome things unlawful, commands lawful wholesome consumption, and calls for protective awareness. That frame turns ijtinab into a precise perimeter around the named configuration, not a generalized ascetic recoil from enjoyment or matter.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate withdrawal supplies a bounded spatial response.
Prohibition and prevention mark the overreach explicitly rejected before the focus.
Wholesomeness opposed to foulness preserves a positive field outside the named perimeter.
Release of a restriction prevents avoidance from expanding into self-made prohibition.
Placing oneself in protection supplies the governing posture for discriminating consumption.

structural_cues: 5:87-88 place anti-overprohibition and lawful wholesome eating immediately before the focus list.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a positive lawful field and a named negative list; I infer that ijtinab draws a discriminating boundary between them. The live alternative is that the preceding commands merely balance, rather than define, the focus command.

changed_reading.before: Avoidance is a broad holiness strategy of withdrawing from suspect pleasures.
changed_reading.after: Avoidance is a targeted act of discrimination that protects lawful, wholesome life from both the named harms and overprohibition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath procedure replaces lot-based extraction and sacrificial division with deliberate, measured repair: a binding act incurs a covering remedy distributed as food from a household's middle standard, clothing, liberation, or fasting. The contrast supplies a constructive economy for what avoidance leaves behind.

activation_trace.role: Gambling lots and partition of a slaughtered animal supply the rejected allocation procedure.
Sacrificial stones connect the rejected allocation to a ritualized slaughter setting.
A deliberately bound obligation supplies accountable causation for the remedy.
Covering or effacing an offense supplies the reparative aim.
Feeding another redirects material distribution toward need.
A just and choice middle supplies a calibrated household standard.
Freedom opposed to bondage makes liberation one concrete distributive repair.

structural_cues: 5:89 specifies quantities, recipients, a middle standard, and ordered alternatives rather than a chance outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies random sacrificial partition in the maysir branch and calibrated feeding or freeing in the oath sequence; I infer a replacement social economy. The live alternative is that oath expiation is locally procedural without intentionally answering maysir.

changed_reading.before: The verse only removes gambling and altar sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: It also clears space for accountable distribution: obligation is repaired by measured provision and release rather than luck, extraction, and ritualized shares.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah opens the focus's compressed causal chain: the shaytan-work makes hostility fall and settle inside the relation between people, then turns them away from remembrance and prayer. Chosen distance from the practices prevents the practices from manufacturing social and devotional distance.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance identify the work's directional tendency.
Voluntary withdrawal supplies the counter-distance.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the insertion of hostility into communal life.
The connection standing between endpoints supplies the relation being damaged.
Enmity names the social separation produced.
Turning away and obstruction supply the devotional blocking action.
Recovering what is held against forgetting names one blocked capacity.
The specified worship names the other blocked practice.
Arrival at an endpoint turns avoidance into actual cessation.

structural_cues: 5:91 repeats khamr and maysir, states two effects, and ends by asking whether the addressees will stop.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaytan as distance, ijtinab as chosen distance, and explicit social and devotional obstruction; I infer a reversal in which one separation prevents another. The alternative is a simpler causal list without spatial counter-patterning.

changed_reading.before: Keep away because the objects are impure.
changed_reading.after: Take deliberate distance from a separator: the practices lodge hostility between people and obstruct the recurrent acts that reconnect attention and worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus calls the cluster rijs from work, and 5:93 answers prior tasting with no guilt while repeating protective awareness, faith, good work, and excellence. This shifts emphasis from irreversible material staining to the direction and quality of an enacted trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Polluting filth supplies the reading that context must qualify.
Intentional action places the focus on practiced agency.
Repeated intentional good work supplies the contrasting action trajectory.
Soundness opposed to corruption qualifies the work that now governs the trajectory.
Inclination toward guilt supplies the burden explicitly negated.
Repeated self-protection supplies an ongoing rather than retroactive moral orientation.

structural_cues: 5:93 negates guilt regarding what was tasted and repeats taqwa, faith, and good action in a staged sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies past tasting without guilt and present repeated good action; I infer that rijs is chiefly the active configuration and trajectory, not an indelible stain from contact. The alternative is a narrower temporal exemption that leaves the ontology of rijs unchanged.

changed_reading.before: Contact or consumption permanently contaminates the person.
changed_reading.after: The warning targets an operated pattern whose present direction can be left; prior tasting is not made into an irreversible identity when the enacted trajectory changes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's erected sacrificial stones are followed by a sacred house, sacred time, offerings, and marked collars made a support for people. Material erection and ritual marking therefore do not produce rijs by themselves; function and authorization distinguish an exploitative altar-system from forms that stabilize public life.

activation_trace.role: Erecting something visibly supplies the broad material image that cannot alone explain condemnation.
An erected worship or slaughter stone specifies the rejected ritual function.
A protected sacred space supplies a positively ordered ritual boundary.
Support and means of livelihood state the public function of the authorized forms.
An offering directed to the sanctuary supplies a non-condemned sacrificial form.
A neck-marker or ornament supplies a positively used visible ritual sign.

structural_cues: 5:97 coordinates house, sacred month, offerings, and collars and assigns them the function qiyaman lil-nas.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negative erected altar and positive sacred materials with a stated public function; I infer a functional and provenance distinction. The alternative is that the positive list is legally separate and does not semantically qualify ansab.

changed_reading.before: Erected ritual objects and sacrificial markers are intrinsically polluting.
changed_reading.after: The rejected object belongs to a harmful authority-and-slaughter system; authorized markers can instead uphold communal order, so material form alone is not the criterion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recurrence of falah denies equality between foul and wholesome even when foul abundance impresses. This exposes the maysir promise of ease and wealth as a quantitative counterfeit: flourishing requires protected discrimination by the inner core, not maximization of winnings or volume.

activation_trace.role: Wealth and abundance supply the alluring quantitative promise.
Polluting foulness supplies the quality concealed by that promise.
Inferior foulness opposed to wholesomeness supplies the qualitative criterion.
Beauty in the eye supplies the perceptual seduction of abundance.
Growth in number supplies scale without goodness.
Self-protection supplies resistance to the impressive display.
Enduring success explicitly closes the qualitative discrimination.

structural_cues: The branchless focus on ulul-albab in 5:100 locates discrimination in the perceiving core rather than the visible count.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maysir's wealth image and a later warning that impressive quantity can remain foul; I infer a counterfeit-falah mechanism. The alternative is that 5:100 gives a general maxim without special reference to gambling's gain structure.

changed_reading.before: Falah is the favorable outcome obtained after obeying a ban.
changed_reading.after: Falah is a trained refusal to confuse impressive quantity and easy wealth with wholesome, durable value.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning against questions whose disclosure harms, followed later by a scene in which respondents disclaim knowledge before the knower of hidden things, activates azlam as an answer-extraction device. The focus then rejects not inquiry itself but engineered certainty that forces the hidden into an actionable sign.

activation_trace.role: A sounding stone that estimates depth while stirring a well supplies a material image of intrusive measurement.
Requesting and asking supply the drive to extract an answer.
Emergence into visibility supplies the demanded disclosure.
What causes distress supplies the cost of disclosure.
Returning speech and answering supply the response whose content is not claimed.
Disclosure to a knower marks the knowledge explicitly disclaimed and ultimately located.
Concealment from sight supplies the domain that the false apparatus claims to penetrate.

structural_cues: The branchless focus term azlam is a decision-sign within the four-item list.
5:101 links questioning, disclosure, and harm; 5:109 explicitly withholds a claimed answer before knowledge of the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a divining-arrow surface, harmful demanded disclosure, and disciplined non-claiming before the unseen; I infer a critique of forced epistemic closure. The live alternative is that 5:101 concerns needless questions generally and 5:109 concerns accountability without a link to azlam.

changed_reading.before: Divining arrows are rejected as an obsolete ritual technique.
changed_reading.after: They exemplify a recurring epistemic vice: forcing uncertainty into an actionable answer when truthful restraint should leave the hidden unclaimed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The animal classifications in 5:103 are humanly made, fabricated as a lie about God, and defended in 5:104 by inherited finding without knowledge or guidance. That sequence expands shaytan's work from private temptation into an institutional production line that erects arbitrary divisions as sacred authority.

activation_trace.role: Making something stand visibly supplies the institutional erection of a rule or authority.
Putting a device to work supplies the humanly operated production mechanism.
Crooked opposition supplies the direction of the fabricated norm.
Making a thing into a designated state supplies institutional classification.
The specific inherited animal category supplies a concrete fabricated ritual taxonomy.
Fabricating a lie supplies false attribution to divine authority.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the absent corrective.
Finding something already present supplies inherited social fact as the claimed warrant.
Ancestral parentage supplies transmission and prestige without proof.
Gentle indication toward truth supplies the guidance the inherited system lacks.

structural_cues: 5:103 lists four animal-rule labels, denies their divine institution, and 5:104 immediately stages an appeal to ancestral precedent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus list of operated ritual devices and a later list of fabricated inherited classifications; I infer a shared mechanism of arbitrary divisions made sacred. The alternative is that the two lists attack distinct practices without inviting a systems-level analogy.

changed_reading.before: The shaytan-work consists mainly of personal indulgence and superstition.
changed_reading.after: It can also be institutional: people manufacture classifications, erect them as sacred authority, and preserve them through inherited prestige despite absent knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The witness sequence resolves uncertainty through present testimony, justice, sworn accountability, investigation of concealed wrongdoing, replacement witnesses, and reversible oaths. It supplies a transparent and corrigible decision procedure in place of the opaque allocation and answer produced by maysir and azlam.

activation_trace.role: Lots and gambling supply an opaque chance procedure for allocating an outcome.
Entangled uncertainty supplies the condition a decision procedure must honestly handle.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies accountable evidence.
Justice in judgment qualifies the witnesses and procedure.
A sworn undertaking distributes responsibility onto named speakers.
Agitated doubt is admitted rather than concealed by false certainty.
Discovery of what was hidden supplies investigation and error detection.
Making truth manifest supplies the corrective aim.
Rejecting a false or defective claim supplies reversibility.
Hearing as understanding and compliance closes the public procedure.

structural_cues: 5:106-108 forms a multi-stage procedure with two witnesses, oath, challenge, replacement, and return of oaths.
The branchless azlam in the focus supplies the contrasting decision device.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chance lots in maysir and a later contestable evidence protocol; I infer that avoidance rejects unaccountable decision technology, not decision under uncertainty itself. The alternative is that inheritance testimony and gambling answer unrelated legal domains.

changed_reading.before: Maysir and azlam are forbidden forms of play and omen-taking.
changed_reading.after: They are also anti-procedures: opaque chance and anonymous signs are replaced by named, just, reviewable testimony that can expose and correct error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus cluster evokes a consuming and distributing social setting organized by intoxicant, gambling shares, slaughter stones, and arrows. The later table sequence offers a rival architecture: a shared table for eating, provision, truthful confirmation, and still hearts, bounded by taqwa and heightened accountability.

activation_trace.role: Intoxicating drink supplies one consumption practice in the destabilizing setting.
Gambling shares of a slaughtered animal supply its divisive distribution practice.
A tray or table bearing food supplies the rival communal setting.
Self-protection bounds the table request before gratification.
Eating names legitimate shared consumption rather than intoxication.
Stillness and reassurance supply the table's intended affective result.
The heart supplies the site stabilized rather than covered or agitated.
Truthful speech supplies confirmation rather than divinatory guesswork.
The repeated table image makes the communal material center explicit.
Apportioned gift supplies provision without gambling extraction.

structural_cues: 5:112-115 moves from a table request through eating, heart-settling, truth-confirmation, provision, warning, and accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies drink, gambling shares, and slaughter in the focus and a bounded shared table later; I infer competing table economies. The live alternative is that the table episode is an independent sign narrative whose food imagery is only analogically related.

changed_reading.before: The focus bans several pleasures and rituals associated with consumption.
changed_reading.after: It rejects a table-order that covers judgment and divides participants, while the wider packet imagines shared provision capable of settling hearts under truth and accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement joins useful truth, fulfilled truthfulness, permanence, and victory, then locates dominion and effective capacity beyond human control. This gives falah a long horizon opposed to maysir's easy wealth and azlam's simulated control: real gain is truthful benefit that lasts.

activation_trace.role: Wealth and ease supply the immediate gain that needs revaluation.
Success as victory and remaining in good supplies the focus's open endpoint.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion for real gain.
Truth realized in promise and action makes benefit dependable.
Persistence resistant to decay supplies durability.
Victory as good and rescue confirms the long-horizon result.
Sovereign dominion limits the gambler's fantasy of acquired control.
Effective capacity to bring about action limits the diviner's simulated mastery.

structural_cues: 5:119 names benefit, truth, permanence, and great victory in one result sequence; 5:120 closes with dominion and capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies falah in the focus and a closing cluster of truthful benefit, durability, victory, dominion, and capacity; I infer that the close fills out falah against lucky gain and manufactured control. The alternative is that the close states a general eschatological outcome without lexical feedback into 5:90.

changed_reading.before: Falah is an unspecified reward for abstention.
changed_reading.after: Falah is durable, truth-bearing benefit under real sovereignty, the opposite of transient lucky wealth and simulated control over outcomes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The image is surprising because it combines distant material branches: enslavement, a long tether, and leading something at one's side. It remains anchored in khamr, shaytan, amal, and ijtinab, but downstream prose should present it as a diagnostic metaphor for captured agency, not as the direct lexical definition of the named practices.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The user of the practices may appear to operate them while khamr, shaytan, amal, and ijtinab carry counter-images of ownership, tethering, employment, and being led.

activation_trace.role: Enslavement or coercive possession supplies capture of the participant.
A long tightly twisted rope used to draw or tether supplies the leash image.
Employing a thing supplies the participant's apparent control of the apparatus.
Leading an animal or captive at one's side reverses who is actually directing whom.

changed_reading.before: A person freely uses several dangerous objects.
changed_reading.after: The operated objects can become a tethering apparatus that recruits, owns, and leads the apparent operator.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sounding-stone branch is materially remote and therefore cannot define rijs here. It remains worth carrying because it is directly anchored in the focus root and coheres with covering, markers, azlam, and confusion; prose should mark it as an exploratory image of an apparatus that muddies what it claims to measure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rijs includes the branch image of a stone dropped into a well to stir sediment or estimate depth by sound.

activation_trace.role: The sounding stone both disturbs sediment and gauges depth, modeling knowledge produced through disturbance.
Covering supplies the obscurity the gauge purports to overcome.
An erected marker supplies the external sign used to orient or measure.

changed_reading.before: Rijs simply labels the cluster as repellent filth.
changed_reading.after: Rijs can also image a muddy depth-gauge: the practice disturbs and obscures reality, then mistakes the resulting signal for reliable knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a distant falah branch concerns embellishing a sale and deceptive inducement, while the surface here plainly promises success. The shared root, maysir's gain structure, later impressive abundance, and final truthful benefit keep the resonance anchored; prose should render it as polemical wordplay, never replace the ordinary success sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tuflihun may reclaim the language of success from practices that market easy gain.

activation_trace.role: Embellishing a sale, deception, and inducing a bid supply a counterfeit marketing of success.
Gambling supplies the product that sells chance as gain.
Appearing beautiful to the eye supplies the sales display.
Numerical abundance supplies the impressive advertised payoff.
Truth fulfilled in action supplies the packet's final contrast to deceptive success-talk.

changed_reading.before: The verse promises success after a straightforward prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The promise may polemically take back the word of flourishing from an apparatus that decorates, advertises, and sells lucky gain as though it were success.

strongest_changes: The four items became one operated social and epistemic system rather than four isolated dirty objects.
Chosen distance in 5:90 became the countermeasure to the social and devotional distance explicitly produced in 5:91.
Lawful consumption and positive sacred markers forced a functional and provenance-based distinction instead of blanket material taboo.
Measured restitution, corrigible testimony, and truthful shared provision emerged as constructive replacements for chance allocation and forced signs.
Falah shifted from generic reward or easy gain to discriminating, truthful benefit that endures.
summary.what_was_special: Across the packet, the focus list was repeatedly reactivated by paired contrasts: lawful and harmful consumption, authorized and fabricated ritual signs, opaque and accountable uncertainty procedures, destabilizing and heart-settling tables, and transient gain versus durable truthful benefit.
remaining_uncertainties: The competing-table reading is a strong cross-pericope analogy but may not be an intended direct contrast.
It remains uncertain how far rijs names the assembled operation rather than qualifying each listed item independently.
Azlam has no focus branch inventory, so its epistemic activations rely on the focus surface and branch-backed context rather than a citable focus branch.
The tether, sounding-well, and sales-trick images are lexical resonances and should not be promoted into direct denotations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Apparent ease veils and entangles agency.** `خ م ر B001` is covering, `ي س ر B001` ready ease, `ر ج س B005` confused entanglement, and `ش ط ن B001` remoteness. I infer that intoxicant and gambling market easy access while covering judgment and moving the agent farther from sound relation.
2. **Success requires lateral distance before cultivation.** `ج ن ب B003` is keeping aside and `ف ل ح B003` tilling split ground. I infer that avoidance clears the field in which lasting good can be cultivated; management within the entanglement is not the proposed mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **An apparent opening veils and entangles.** Fixed **خ م ر / B001** (“covering and veiling”) supplies intoxication’s cognitive action, while fixed **ي س ر / B001** (“ease and ready opening”) shadows gambling’s apparent accessibility. Fixed **ر ج س / B005** (“confused entanglement”) names their combined state. 5:87–5:89 carefully opened goods and repaired bindings; 5:91 shows these practices instead producing hostility and obstruction. I infer that promised ease recruits the user into a system that covers judgment and tangles relations. Avoidance reads as spatial refusal to enter that mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:91 explicitly disclosed the mechanism only announced here: veiled and apparently easy practices land hostility between people and turn attention away from prayer.

Haber ile tanıklığı gizleme ve birinden utanma kullanımları da görünürlüğü ya da açığa vurmayı engelleyen uzantılar olarak aynı dalda korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak örtme çekirdeği ile kadın başlığı, kabı veya evi örtme, haberi ya da tanıklığı gizleme ve utanma gibi biçime bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görünmesini, açığa çıkmasını ya da dışarıyla doğrudan temasını engelleyecek biçimde örtmek veya gizlemektir. Bu çekirdek, kadın başlığına ve kap ya da ev örtmeye; mecaz yoluyla haber ve tanıklığı saklamaya, ayrıca birinin karşısında utanmaya uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi üstüne veya önüne engel getirerek örtmek, görünmez kılmak ya da korunak içine almaktır.
Kadının başını örttüğü başlık ile kap ve evin üstünü ya da açıklığını kapatma, somut çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Haberin saklı kalması ve tanıklığın gizlenmesi, görünürlüğün bilgi alanına aktarılmış uzantılarıdır.
Bir kimsenin karşısında utanma kullanımı, kendini açığa vurmaktan çekinme ile bağlantılıdır.

İçkiyi yapan veya satan kişi, sürekli içen kimse ve sarhoşluğun ardından kalan sersemlik bu alana bağlı adlandırmalardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karışma ve yaklaşma çekirdeği korunur; hastalığın ya da hüznün içine işlemesi, bir yerde kalma ve sırtlana söylenen aldatıcı söz yalnızca kendi biçimlerinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeye yaklaşması, onunla karışması veya içine işleyip orada kalmasıdır. Hastalık ve hüzün bir kişinin içine yerleşebilir; kişi de bir yere bağlanıp ayrılmadan kalabilir.

Bir kimsenin bulunduğu yeri bırakmadan orada kalması, temasın süreklilik yönüne uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yaklaşma, karışma ve bağlı kalmayı ortak alanda toplar; hastalık ve hüzün içe işlerken kişi bir yeri bırakmadan kalabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hamuru bekletip iyi hale getirme ile hamura maya katmayı aynı üretim alanında birleştirir ve ayrıca kapta bırakılan bir şeyin tadının değişmesini daha geniş bir uygulama olarak verir. Dal bu süreç ile başlatıcı maddeyi ayırarak korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hamurun olgunlaşması çekirdekte, maya maddesi ve kapta bekletilerek tadı değiştirilen başka şeyler ise kendi biçimlerine bağlı olarak tanımlanır.

facets.statement: Hamuru bir süre bekleterek olgunlaştırmak ve iyi duruma getirmektir.
Hamura maya katmak, beklemeyle oluşacak değişimi başlatan özel işlemdir.
Bir kaba konan başka bir şeyi tadı değişinceye kadar bekletmek, sürecin hamur dışındaki uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hamurun bekleyerek iyileşmesi ile içine maya konmasını aynı süreçte buluşturur; kapta bırakılan başka bir maddenin tat değiştirmesi bu sürecin daha geniş uygulamasıdır.

Geçici dal başlığı ilk kullanımı doğru yansıtır, ancak ikinci kullanım karşıt katılımcı yönüyle bağımsız bir biçime bağlı çeşitleme olarak açıkça korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlamlar yalnızca kaynakta verilen türemiş yapılara bağlıdır: biri kişiyi zorla köle veya mülk yapar, diğeri bir şeyi armağan edip alıcının mülkü kılar.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir türemiş yapıda bir kişiyi veya topluluğu köleleştirmek ve zorla mülk edinmektir. Başka bir yapıda ise bir şeyi birine armağan ederek onun mülkiyetine geçirmek anlamına gelir.

facets.statement: Bir kişiyi veya topluluğu köleleştirerek zorla mülk edinmektir.
Başka bir türemiş yapıda bir şeyi armağan etmek ve alıcının mülküne geçirmek anlamı bulunur.
İki kullanımda da mülkiyet ilişkisi kurulur, fakat ilkinde kişi zorla nesneleştirilir, ikincisinde eşya isteyerek devredilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kişiyi ya da topluluğu köleleştirip zorla mülk edinme anlamında birleşir; bir şeyi armağan ederek mülkiyetini verme ise aynı toplam iddiada farklı yapıya bağlı bir çeşitleme olarak aktarılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiler arası anlayış ve zorluk çıkarmama yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalın kolaylık ve bir şeyin kendiliğinden hazır duruma gelmesi de kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir işin önünü açma ve yapılmasını sağlayacak yolu belirginleştirme öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir işteki engeli azaltma ve onun yapılmasını kolaylaştırma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal durum, oluş ve oldurma anlamlarını birlikte taşır; komşu dal özellikle bir işin yolunu açan etkin kolaylaştırmayı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşu adayları karşılaştırıldı; en yakın sınır karışıklığını kolay ve hafif olma ile işi etkin biçimde kolaylaştırma dalları oluşturduğu için yalnızca bunlar yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi maddi genişlik ve varlıklılığı, ayrıca bir kimsenin varlıklı duruma gelmesini açıkça bildirir. Dal çerçevesi durum ile bu duruma geçişi birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte taşıyabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, varlıklı olma durumunu bu duruma geçmeyi bildiren türemiş kullanımdan ayırır ve ikisini maddi olanakla sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Maddi olanakların bol olması ve kişinin varlıklı bulunmasıdır. Türemiş kullanım, kişinin sonradan bu duruma erişmesini bildirir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, maddi olanak bolluğu ve varlıklı olma durumudur.
Bir kişinin varlıklı duruma gelmesi, durum çekirdeğinin oluş bildiren uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar maddi genişlik ile varlıklılık anlamlarında birleşir; bir kişinin varlıklı duruma gelmesini bildiren eylem de bu durumun oluş uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin veya durumun yeterli ve bol maddi olanağa sahip oluşunu anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Maddi genişlik, bolluk ve varlıklı olma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin önceki durumundan çıkarak yeterli veya bol maddi olanağa eriştiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Varlıklılığa geçiş sürecini açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Süregelen maddi bolluk durumunu ad olarak karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Varlıklı duruma gelmeyi bildiren belirli oluş kullanımı bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Maddi gücün yanında yapabilme gücü ve genel yeterlilik kapsamı da vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin maddi bakımdan geniş olanaklara sahip olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal maddi varlıklılık durumuna ve ona erişmeye odaklanır; komşu dal maddi alanın ötesinde yapabilme gücü ve yeterliliğe de uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Varlıklılığın süregelen durumunu ve maddi genişliği de adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Önceden yoksul olma koşulunu özellikle gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin varlıklı duruma geçmesini bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal geçiş için önceki bir yoksulluk koşulu koymaz; komşu dalın ayırt edici sınırı varlığın yoksulluktan sonra kazanılmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; genel varlıklılık ile yoksulluktan sonra varlıklı olma dalları, durum ve geçiş sınırlarını en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الميسرة واليسار واليسارة بمعنى السعة والغنى، وأيسر الرجل إذا استغنى.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الميسرة والميسرة: السعة والغنى؛ واليسار واليسارة: الغنى، وقد أيسر الرجل أي استغنى (sihah)؛ الميسرة واليسار عبارة عن الغنى (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اليسار لليد أو خلاف اليمين، والأيسر خلاف الأيمن، والميسرة خلاف الميمنة، والتياسر أو المياسرة بمعنى الأخذ ذات اليسار، ومن يعمل بكلتا يديه.
يدخل فيه وصف الإنسان أو الفرس باللين وسرعة المتابعة، والقوائم الخفاف، وحسن نقل القوائم في الدابة.
يدخل فيه قولهم يسرت الغنم إذا كثر لبنها ونسلها.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi fal oklarıyla oynanan geleneksel talih oyununu, bu oyuna katılanları ve kesilen devenin parçalarını oklarla paylaştırma işlemini birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi oyun, katılımcı ve paylaştırma aşamalarını koruyarak kaynağı doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, oyunun adını katılımcı adlarından ve devenin kesilip parçalarının oklarla paylaştırılmasını bildiren eylem biçimlerinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Fal oklarıyla oynanan geleneksel bir talih oyunu ve bu oyunun çevresindeki paylaştırma düzenidir. Katılımcılar bir deveyi keser, parçalarını okların belirlediği paylara göre bölüşür.

facets.statement: Temel kurum, fal oklarıyla oynanan geleneksel talih oyunudur.
Oyunu oynayan kişi ve oyuna katılmak üzere toplanan topluluk ayrı adlandırmalara konu olur.
Katılımcıların deveyi kesip parçalarını oklarla belirlenen paylara göre bölüşmesi düzenin kurucu işlemidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar fal oklarına dayalı talih oyunu, oyuna katılan kişiler ve kesilen devenin parçalarını oklarla belirlenen paylara göre bölüşme işlemlerinde birleşir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal oyun düzenini ve paylaştırma işlemini bütünüyle anlatır; komşu dal yalnızca bir oyuncu türünü veya belirli bir oyun okunu adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Payın fal oklarıyla oynanan oyunda ve kesilen deve üzerinden belirlenmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir bağlamdaki belirli pay veya hak genel olarak kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir bütünden kişiye ayrılan pay düşüncesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal payı belirli bir oyun, kesim ve ok çekme düzenine bağlar; komşu dal payı bu tarihsel koşullar olmadan genel olarak adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün oyun aracı, oyuncu ve pay adayları incelendi; oyuncu veya ok adı ile genel pay kavramı, bütün oyun düzeninin sınırını en açık gösteren karşılaştırmalardır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الأيسار: القوم يجتمعون على الميسر، واحدهم يسر؛ والميسر: القمار (maqayis)؛ الميسر: قمار العرب بالأزلام؛ الياسر: اللاعب بالقداح؛ اليسر والياسر بمعنى والجمع أيسار؛ يسر القوم الجزور أي اجتزروها واقتسموا أعضاءها (sihah)

root_profile.summary: Kök, kolaylık ve hazır oluş çevresindeki merkezden azlık, maddi bolluk, sol yön, uyumlu hareket, hayvancılık, tarihsel talih oyunu, beden izleri ve teknik yönelimlere uzanan çok dallı bir anlam yapısı taşır. Yer ve kişi adları ile genç erkek anlamı daha bağımsız uçlarda yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın kimliği, bir şeyi dik ve belirgin duracak biçimde yerleştirme veya yükseltme çekirdeğini doğru yansıtır. Boynuz, göğüs ve baş gibi bölümlerin dik durması ile tozun yükselmesi aynı uzamsal görünümün geçişsiz gerçekleşmeleridir; perde kaldırma ve tuzak kurma ise belirli nesnelerle sınırlı kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dikme ve dik durma çekirdeğini özel nesnelerle kurulan perde kaldırma, tuzak kurma ve kazan desteği gibi kullanımlardan açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi dik, çıkıntılı veya belirgin duracak biçimde yerleştirmek ya da yükseltmek; ayrıca bir varlığın veya bölümünün bu biçimde dik durmasıdır. Tozun yükselmesi ve belirli nesnelerin kurulması bu uzamsal çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi dik, çıkıntılı veya belirgin duracak biçimde yerleştirme ya da yükseltme.
Bir insanın, hayvanın, boynuzun veya göğsün dik ve yükselmiş durumda bulunması.
Toz gibi dağınık bir maddenin havaya yükselerek belirginleşmesi.
Perdeyi kaldırma, av için tuzak kurma veya kazanı taşıyacak demir desteği yerleştirme gibi nesneye bağlı uygulamalar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Anlamın ortak çekirdeği, bir şeyi dik ve görünür konuma getirme ile bu konumda bulunmadır. Nesne örnekleri mızrak, yapı, taş, perde ve tuzağı; durum örnekleri ise dik boynuz, yükselmiş göğüs ve havaya kalkmış tozu kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel bir nesnenin dik konuma getirilmesini veya bir varlığın dik ve yükselmiş durumda bulunmasını birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Geçişli dikme işlemini ve geçişsiz dik durma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mızrak, taş, direk, yapı veya benzeri bir nesne dik konuma getirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi dik ve belirgin konuma getiren fiziksel işlemi tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın, hayvanın ya da beden bölümünün yükselmiş ve dik durumda bulunmasını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı veya beden bölümü için dik ve yükselmiş durumu eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tozun yerden kalkıp havada belirginleştiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tozun yukarı doğru hareket edip görünür hâle gelmesini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal, dikilmiş taşın tapınma, çevresinde dönme, adak kesme veya kan dökme amacıyla kullanılan kutsal nesne oluşunu doğru biçimde birleştirir. Taşın yalnızca dikili olması yeterli değildir; dinsel yönelim ya da kesim işlevi anlamın ayırt edici koşuludur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın taş adını dinsel işleviyle verir ve başka dallardaki sıradan dikili taş anlamlarını bu çekirdeğe katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tapınmak, çevresinde dönmek, yakınlık sunmak veya üzerinde adak kesip kan dökmek için dikilmiş taş ya da bu tür taşlardan oluşan kutsal nesnedir.

facets.statement: Tapınılmak veya çevresinde dinsel tören yapılmak üzere dikilmiş taş.
Üzerinde adak hayvanı kesilen veya kan dökülen dikili taş.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, taşın dikilmiş olmasını tapınma ve kesim törenleriyle birlikte verir. Taş hem tapınılan bir nesne hem de adak hayvanının kesildiği ve kanının döküldüğü tören odağı olabilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinsel amaçla dikilmiş, tapınılan ya da üzerinde adak hayvanı kesilen taş için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Taşın dikili oluşunu ve tapınma ya da kesim işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın taş üzerinde kesildiği veya kanının taş üzerine döküldüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النصب والأنصاب: حجارة منصوبة كانت تعبد أو يذبح عليها أو تصب عليها دماء الذبائح

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal, bir topluluğu ya da sınırı gösteren dikili işaret ile kuyu veya havuz kenarına yerleştirilen taşları kaynak ifadesine uygun biçimde kapsar. Taşlardan yapılmış havuz adı bu yerleştirme düzeninden doğan adlaşmış bir uzantıdır; tapınma işlevi bu dalın parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın adların işaret ve su yapısı anlamlarını kapsar; başka bir yapıya özgü deyimsel anlam eklemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğu veya sınırı göstermek için dikilen işaret ya da kuyu ve havuz kenarına destek veya çevre oluşturacak biçimde yerleştirilen taştır. Taşlardan kurulmuş havuzun kendisi de bu düzenlemeden doğan adlaşmış bir anlamdır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun yerini veya bir bölgenin sınırını bildirmek üzere dikilmiş işaret taşı.
Kuyu ya da havuz ağzının çevresine kenar ve destek oluşturacak biçimde yerleştirilen taş.
Çevresi taşlarla kurulmuş havuzun kendisi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, bir yeri belli eden veya bir su yapısının kenarını oluşturan dikili taştır. Kullanım, topluluk işaretinden bölge sınırına, kuyu ve havuz çevresindeki taşlara ve bu taşlarla yapılmış havuz adına uzanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir yeri belirleyen dikili işaretlerle kuyu ya da havuz çevresine yerleştirilen taşları kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: İşaret işlevini ve su yapısının çevresindeki taş düzenini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yerini veya kutsal sayılan bir bölgenin sınırını belirtme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dikili taşın yer veya sınır bildiren işaret işlevini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, taş olma veya dikilme koşulu aramadan kuyu ve havuzun yanlarını genel olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kuyu ve havuz ağzının çevresindeki kenar yapısını gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kenarı oluşturan dikili taşlara dayanır; komşu dal ise kenarın kendisini malzemesinden ve kurulma biçiminden bağımsız olarak belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal, temel, dönüş noktası ve sabit ölçü düşüncesini taşıyan kullanımları doğru toplar; ancak bunlar tek bir yalın ve her bağlama uygulanabilir anlam değildir. Bıçak sapı, mali yükümlülük eşiği, soy kökeni ve güneşin batış yeri yalnızca kendi söz kalıpları içinde korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak temel ve sabit başvuru noktasını verir; bıçak, mal, soy ve güneşle kurulan anlamları ayrı ve kalıba bağlı uzmanlaşmalar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin dayandığı temel, döndüğü başvuru noktası veya sabitlenmiş ölçüsüdür. Bu çekirdek, yalnızca belirli kullanımlarda bıçağın sapını, mali yükümlülük doğuran alt eşiği, kişinin köken ve soyunu ya da güneşin batış yerini gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin dayandığı temel, köken, dönüş noktası veya sabit başvuru ölçüsü.
Bıçağın elde tutulan sapı veya arka bölümü.
Malın belirli bir mali yükümlülüğü doğurduğu sabit alt miktar.
Bir kişinin geldiği köken, yetiştiği soy ve bu kökene dayanan saygınlık.
Güneşin gün sonunda döner gibi görünüp battığı yer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak malzeme temel ve geri dönülen başvuru noktası çevresinde toplanır, fakat kullanımlar güçlü biçimde sözlüksel sınırlıdır. Bıçak sapı, mali eşik, soy kökeni ve güneşin batış yeri aynı genel sözcük ailesinin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın söz kalıplarına göre köken, dayanak, dönüş noktası veya belirlenmiş eşik olarak gerçekleşen ortak çekirdeğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Temel olma ile sabit bir dönüş veya ölçü noktası olma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bıçağın elde tutulan arka bölümü veya ona sonradan takılan sap anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bıçağın elde tutulan sap veya arka bölümünü eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit mal miktarının yükümlülüğü başlatan alt eşik oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin geldiği aile çizgisi, kökeni ve buna bağlı saygınlığı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin ailesel kökenini ve geldiği soy çizgisini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşin gün sonunda ufukta kaybolduğu yeri tam olarak korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, duyusal kirden insanın niteliğine ve kötü ya da tiksindirici sayılan davranışlara uzanan ortak bir tiksindiricilik alanı kurar. Lekeleme ve karıştırma açıklaması bu çekirdeği destekler, fakat tek başına bütün dalın tanımı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın pislik çekirdeğini, kişi ve eylem kullanımlarını ve kalıba bağlı nitelemeleri ayrı tutar; kalıba özgü bir kullanım bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Pis veya tiksindirici sayılan şey, kişi, nitelik ya da davranıştır. Değdiğini lekeleyip başka şeylerle karıştırma, bu kirliliğin açıklanan bir yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin veya kişinin pis, tiksindirici ve temizliğe aykırı sayılması anlamın çekirdeğidir.
Kötü ve tiksindirici sayılan davranışlar da somut kirlilik çekirdeğinin bir uzantısı olarak bu alana girer.
Kirlilik, değdiğini lekeleyen ve başka şeylerle karıştıran bir nitelik olarak da açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıkların ortak çizgisi, somut kir ile kötü ve sakınılması gereken davranışları tiksindiricilik ölçüsünde birleştirir. Lekeleme ve karıştırma açıklaması bu ortak anlamın oluş biçimini belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade bir işin karışması, belirsizleşmesi ve kişinin o iş içinde dönüp durması anlamlarını birlikte verir. Hazırlanmış çerçeve hem durumun karışıklığını hem de bunun doğurduğu yön bulamama halini doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bir işle kurulan kalıba bağlı karışıklık ve dönüp durma yönünü yalın biçimdeki belirsizlik kullanımından ayırır; ikisi tek bir sınırsız anlama dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin öğelerinin birbirine karışıp durumun belirsizleşmesi ve kişinin bu iş içinde yön bulamadan dönüp durmasıdır.

facets.statement: Araç, bir ipe bağlanarak kuyuya indirilen veya doğrudan kuyuya atılan bir taştır.
Taşın bir işlevi kuyunun dibindeki çamuru çalkalayıp karıştırmaktır.
Taşın başka bir işlevi, kuyu içinde çıkardığı sesten suyun dibini ve derinliğini belirlemektir.
Araç adından türeyen eylem, kuyudaki suyun derinliğini bu taşla ölçmeyi bildirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجنوب الريح، هبوبها، الدخول في الجنوب، وإصابة القوم بها، والسحابة المجنوبة.
يدخل فيه اشتكى جنبه، ذات الجنب، المجنوب، ضربه فجنبه، وجنب البعير من شدة العطش حتى تلتصق رئته بجنبه أو يلتوي.
يدخل فيه جنب القوم أو بنو فلان إذا قلت ألبان إبلهم أو لم يكن في إبلهم لبن، وعام تجنيب.
يدخل فيه خير مجنب أو شر مجنب بمعنى كثير، وما جعلته بعض المصادر كأنه إلى جنب الإنسان.
يدخل فيه الجنبة اسم عام لنبات يترك في الصيف أو يتربل فيه، مما له أرومة ويبقى في المحل ويعصم المال.
يدخل فيه المجنب بمعنى الترس، وما روي بمعنى الستر، باعتباره شيئا إلى جنب الإنسان أو يحمي جانبه.
يدخل فيه التجنيب في رجل الفرس أو قوائمه، والمجنب من الخيل البعيد ما بين الرجلين من غير فجج، وما وصف بأنه إبعاد إحدى الرجلين عن الأخرى خلقة.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uğur, bereket ve bir şeyden hayır umma anlamlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal olumlu sonuç, iyilik ve esenlik alanında buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Özel öğün adının gerekçesi, gücün ve orucun sürmesi düşüncesi üzerinden kalıcılık anlamına bağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal soyut olumlu sonucu bildirir; komşu dal bu sonuçla gerekçelendirilen belirli bir öğünü adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi alışverişi taraflara çekici göstermeyi, yalanla kandırmayı, sahte artırımla başkasını yanıltmayı ve alaya almayı aynı dalda sıralar. Ancak ilk kullanım açıkça kandırma şartı taşımaz; bu nedenle dal korunmalı, fakat çekici gösterme ile aldatıcı kullanımlar tek bir eylemmiş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, taraflara bağlı alışveriş yapılarını ve kandırma yapılarını ayrı yüzler olarak gösterir; bunlardan genel ve sınırsız bir yalın anlam üretmez.

concept_map.definition: Satış ve alışverişi satıcıya ya da alıcıya çekici göstermek. Ayrı yapılarda ise yalan söyleyerek kandırmak, başkasını daha yüksek bedel vermeye çekmek için bedeli artırmak veya alaya almak.

facets.statement: Satış ve alışverişi satıcıya veya alıcıya çekici göstermek.
Bir topluluğu kandırmak ve onlara gerçeğe aykırı söz söylemek.
Bir kiracının başkasını daha yüksek bedel vermeye kandırmak için bedeli artırması.
Başkalarını kandırma ve alaya alma davranışı.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak, alışverişi taraflara çekici gösterme kullanımının yanında yalanla kandırma, yanıltıcı bedel artırımı ve alaya alma kullanımlarını da kaydeder.

source_details.summary: Alışverişi çekici gösterme ile kandırma, yanıltıcı bedel artırımı ve alaya alma kullanımlarının tamamı bu tek tanıklıkta yer alır.

concept_gloss.text: alışverişi çekici gösterme; yalanla kandırma ve alaya alma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın çekici gösterme yüzüyle açıkça aldatıcı ve alaycı yüzlerini birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte gösteren üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekici gösterme, kandırma ve alaya alma yüzlerini ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.text: satış ve alışverişi taraflara çekici göstermek
contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün satıcı veya alıcı yararına alışverişi cazip gösterme yapısında kullanıldığı bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Alışveriş alanını, tarafları ve çekici gösterme işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gerçeğe aykırı söz, kandırma veya alaya alma bildiren yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yalan söyleme, kandırma ve alaya alma davranışlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kiracının başka birini daha yüksek bedel vermeye yöneltmek için görünürde bedel artırdığı özel kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Bedel artırma işlemini, yanıltma amacını ve hedef kişiyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal çekici gösterme ile aldatmayı aynı olay içinde buluşturabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal aldatıcı biçimde süslenmiş söze odaklanır; bu dal alışveriş davranışlarını, doğrudan kandırmayı ve alayı da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Satış ve alışverişi çekici gösteren ya da ticari işlemde başkasını yanıltan davranıştır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Satış, alış ve bedel artırma olayları pazar ve alışveriş alanında gerçekleşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal ticaretin yerini ve genel etkinliğini adlandırır; bu dal o alandaki belirli yönlendirme ve aldatma davranışlarını anlatır.
